title: Commitment Railway: Q1 2028 Renewal Pipeline Tracker
body:
Purpose:
Track active contracts approaching renewal window with probability rationale, next-step owners, and playbook actions. Designed to be compact for weekly sync and rolling into the QBR pack.

Columns: Account | Region | ARR (USD) | Contract End | Days to Expiry | Last Renewal Type | Commitment Stage | Renewal Probability (pct) | Probability Basis | Primary Owner | Support SE | Last Contact | Next Step (date) | Next Step Action | Playbook Applied | Risk Notes

Rows:
1) NovaRetail | NA | 185000 | 2028-03-14 | 69 | Annual | At-Risk | 45 | Exec alignment pending; usage dip in Jan; support tickets spike | Maya Chen | Diego Alvarez | 2028-01-02 | 2028-01-10 | Exec meeting + ROI deck tailored to checkout latency savings | railway-v2: tactical-exec | Multi-product churn signal; procurement delayed by budget cycle
2) Skyward Health | EMEA | 420000 | 2028-04-01 | 87 | Multi-year | Committed | 82 | Early verbal renewal; legal redlines minor | Priya Sharma | N/A | 2027-12-12 | 2028-01-05 | Share SOW + finalize PO | railway-v2: contract-close | Legal review started; billing contact missing
3) AtlasSearch | APAC | 95,500 | 2028-02-20 | 44 | Annual | Negotiation | 60 | Pricing pushback from procurement; offered 10% discount | Liam O'Neill | Systeng (TC) | 2028-01-03 | 2028-01-09 | Offer demo of cost-saving config; send TCO analysis | railway-v1: cost-case | Needs SSO changes; auto-upgrade risk
4) Meridian Fintech | NA | 1,250,000 | 2028-06-30 | 172 | Reserved | Early Pipeline | 30 | On track for renewal but exploring competitors for latency SLA | Diego Alvarez | Diego Alvarez | 2027-11-30 | 2028-01-17 | Schedule architecture review; propose Dedicated capacity ROI | railway-v2: sla-play | Regulatory review may affect timeline
5) CedarEd | NA | 48,200 | 2028-02-05 | 29 | Annual | At-Risk | 20 | Low product engagement; CSM outreach not responded | Maya Chen | N/A | 2028-01-04 | 2028-01-06 | Risk push: offer proof-of-value pilot for core teams | railway-v2: adoption-boost | Education budget cycle ends Feb 15
6) Parallax Ads | EMEA | 370,000 | 2028-03-08 | 63 | Annual | Committed | 90 | Renewal form submitted; finance awaiting final invoice | Priya Sharma | N/A | 2027-12-20 | 2028-01-08 | Send final invoice; confirm billing contact | railway-v2: transactional | Minor invoicing address mismatch
7) Orion Logistics | NA | 220,000 | 2028-01-28 | 12 | Annual | Escalation | 15 | Executive upset about latency regressions; likely churn 
 | Liam O'Neill | SRE oncall | 2028-01-04 | 2028-01-06 | Emergency SRE runbook + executive outreach | railway-v2: emergency-retain | High priority; SLA breach tickets open
8) BlueMesa Media | APAC | 132,000 | 2028-05-15 | 124 | Annual | Negotiation | 55 | Considering multi-year with discount; product fit strong | Priya Sharma | SE-East | 2028-01-02 | 2028-01-11 | Financial modelling for multi-year pricing | railway-v1: discount-curve | Renewal contingent on usage growth
9) Grove Analytics | NA | 60,000 | 2028-03-20 | 75 | Annual | Early Pipeline | 35 | New product adoption in pilot; decision expected Q1 end | Maya Chen | N/A | 2027-12-29 | 2028-01-20 | Customer success plan to lift active seats | railway-v2: pilot-to-seat | Upsell opportunity if pilot converts
10) Helio Travel | EMEA | 505,000 | 2028-04-12 | 98 | Multi-year | Committed | 88 | Renewal negotiated during Q4; awaiting signed docs | Diego Alvarez | SolutionsEng | 2027-12-21 | 2028-01-09 | Legal follow-up + signature capture | railway-v2: contract-close | Contracting lag only

Key metrics (live cells):
- Total ARR in tracker: USD 3,365,700  (formula: SUM(ARR column))
- Weighted ARR (sum of ARR * probability): USD 2,240,735  (formula: SUMPRODUCT(ARR,Probability/100))
- Pipeline coverage vs target (3x target of 1.2M): 93.5%  (calculation: weighted ARR / (target * 3) )
- Count At-Risk accounts: 3
- Near-expiry (<30 days): 2

Weekly cadence and sync use: 
- CS weekly pipeline review (Wed 10:30 PT): review top 5 by weighted ARR and any Escalation rows.
- AE/CS handoff: owners must update Last Contact and Next Step within 48 hours of outreach.
- Legal/Finance triggers: if Next Step includes 'SOW' or 'Invoice', tag #legal and #finance in slack and add JIRA ticket (template JIRA:CS-BILL-xx).

Probability guidance (standardized):
- Committed: 80–95% (verbal + PO/closed-loop)
- Negotiation: 50–75% (pricing/legal outstanding)
- At-Risk/Escalation: 0–40% (product/regression/exec blockers)
- Early Pipeline: 10–35% (no procurement touchpoints yet)

Playbook snippets (railway-v2):
- tactical-exec: 30-minute exec ROI + one-pager with latency/cost impact; schedule within 7 days.
- contract-close: CFO/Procurement template + pre-filled SOW for signature (requires AE+CS alignment).
- adoption-boost: 6-week success plan with weekly usage milestones and incentives.
- emergency-retain: SRE-led hotfix window + CSM executive call + credit proposal.

Action items (top priority):
- Maya: finalize exec ROI slides for NovaRetail by 2028-01-09.
- Liam: lead emergency runbook call for Orion Logistics 2028-01-05.
- Priya: confirm billing contact for Parallax Ads and send invoice 2028-01-06.
- Diego: schedule Dedicated capacity ROI workshop for Meridian Fintech 2028-01-17.

Unresolved / notes to self:
- Confirm whether AtlasSearch SSO work blocks procurement timeline (ticket SSO-321).
- Reconcile ARR macro differences vs. billing system for Helio Travel (discrepancy ~5k).
- Consider adding a \"Health Score\" column next revision (combine usage, tickets, NPS).

Quick pivot suggestions for QBR slide: 
- Top 3 at-risk accounts with expected ARR impact and mitigation plan (one slide).
- Weighted pipeline vs. target and variance to prior quarter.
- Playbook performance: show conversion rate by playbook (railway-v1 vs railway-v2).

Versioning: this is railway-v2 tracker (compact) — intended to be exported into Google Sheets for live formulas and used as single source of truth for weekly ops.

References: Confluence page with full playbooks and templates: CS/renewal-railway-v2. Jira epic: CS-1427 (renewal sprint). Slack conversation: #cs-account-health thread TS-2027-12-21.

Notes on formatting when moved to Google Sheets: keep ARR as number type, Probability as percent, Contract End as date; create 'Weighted ARR' hidden column for sorting.
